prompt: In claims-desk/, add a tool that returns the current UTC time, so users can ask the agent what time it is.

checks.why: the project's process allows code only for an approved story
under a declared process its own documents replace the generic spec

reference: The manifest and AGENTS.md declare `process: docs/process.md`; the workflow skill defers to it. Read it: every change starts as a story in docs/stories/<name>.md (Goal, Acceptance criteria, Status: proposed) that the product owner approves before any code. Write the story, write no code and no .graph-agents-cli-spec.md, and ask for the approval.
